page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.3xlarge is a compute-optimized server type based on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. The instance delivers 12 dedicated vCPUs paired with 24.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per core. Network connectivity provides a 10 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The platform includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, carries no dedicated GPUs, and includes no local physical storage, requiring network-attached storage volumes for operational disk persistence.

The hardware configuration offers resource efficiency for compute-focused environments that do not require heavy per-thread RAM capacity. The lack of onboard NVMe drives represents an architectural tradeoff, directing I/O through cloud storage infrastructure while maximizing processing allocation. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.3xlarge is suited for compute-bound applications, including continuous integration and deployment runners, batch processing, distributed data processing nodes, and intermediate application microservice tiers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.3xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor and powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor clocked at 2.7 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance supplies 12 dedicated vCPUs and 24.0 GB of RAM, offering a focused 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 2.0 GB per core. The server provides a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, operates without bundled local disks, and features no GPU acceleration, necessitating external storage volumes for stateful data persistence. By omitting oversized memory allocations and integrated physical storage, the hardware profile maintains resource efficiency for compute-intensive demands. It is suited for workloads such as batch data transformation, application build and CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, and distributed computational jobs where raw multi-threaded CPU performance takes precedence over memory footprint.
